scope: I checked every dossier quote against its saved file in sources/ (all are present), and reread the graph-relevant findings and corrections against Bava Batra 152a-153a, Rashbam, Tosafot, Tosafot Rid, Ri Migash, Yad Ramah, Rif, Shita Mekubetzet, Rabbeinu Gershom and the Soncino HTML, plus the pilot output. I fetched nothing new, checked no manuscripts, and did not look at the Gittin, Shevuot or Sanhedrin pages beyond what the dossier saved.

findings.target: pilot entities giver, first, second, sick, others (not addressed in dossier or reading.md)
findings.reason: The pilot lists the donor and recipients of 'כתב לזה וכתב לזה', 'ראשון' / 'שני', and the 'שכיב מרע שכתב כל נכסיו לאחרים' of the question sent to Shmuel as kind 'person' or 'group'. These are roles in hypothetical legal cases: the anonymous Gemara's 'פשיטא' case, Rav and Shmuel's ruling, and a question framed as 'ילמדנו רבינו ... מהו'. They are not historical people. The dossier, and the previous review, left them as person nodes. They should be requalified as legal roles attached to their statements, with no person node and no edge to any sage.

findings.target: F13 / A3 (wording of the Pumbedita question)
findings.reason: The dossier misses the largest witness group, which has the short question 'קנו מידו מהו' with no 'שכיב מרע שכתב כל נכסיו לאחרים'. That group is Tosafot Rid's own text ('ילמדנו רבי' קנו מידו מהו'), Ri Migash, Yad Ramah and the Rosh as quoted in Shita Mekubetzet. Yad Ramah reads it as continuing the 'wrote and conferred' case ('כלומר קנו מידו לראשון, שכתב וזיכה לו'). The dossier also does not say that Tosafot Rid rejects his 'יש ספרים' reading. He rejects it because Sura and Pumbedita must disagree ('משמע דפליגי סוריא ופומבדיתא ואלו כן לא פליגי'). So A2 cannot count that remark as independent support for disagreement; a text choice made to keep the disagreement cannot then prove it. The pilot's 'sick' and 'others' roles belong only to the printed wording.

findings.target: F10 and the correction adding a בי רב -> Rav affiliation
findings.reason: Keeping the name-embedded link is right under project rules, and so is refusing any 'after Rav's death' scope, date or student_of edge. I found no traditional commentary in the saved files that mentions Rav's death here. But the dossier does not mark that 'בי רב' may be a fixed word for 'the academy' rather than the house of the person Rav. Soncino's main text renders it '[The following enquiry] was sent from the academy' and gives 'from the school of Rab' only as a bracketed alternative. The affiliation claim should carry a 'possibly generic term, not literal kinship or membership' flag.

findings.target: F8 and the correction adding a speech claim for Rav Yirmeya bar Abba
findings.reason: Support adding his own 'אמר' speech/transmission claim. It should be nested: the anonymous Gemara says 'בפומבדיתא מתנו הכי', and inside that teaching Rav Yirmeya bar Abba reports the exchange. Keep c8 child_of Abba, scoped to readings that carry 'בר אבא', and mark that the patronymic may be a fixed name. The Rosh as quoted in the Shita has only 'רב ירמיה', and the Rabbeinu Chananel version in Rashbam ('בפומבדיתא מתנו שלחו מבי רב לשמואל') has no reporter at all; both should be recorded as name-form evidence, not as a reading that deletes him. Drop the dossier's remark that 153a:8 'fits someone tied to Rav's rulings'. There the speaker of 'אמר הכא אתרא דשמואל' is unnamed in the Hebrew (Davidson supplies Rav Nahman), and the line says nothing about what the man in Shum Tamya holds or who he is tied to.

findings.target: F3 / A6 and the correction adding the 152a transmission chain
findings.reason: The Wikisource text at 152a:1 does read 'בי רב משמיה דרב אמרי ארכביה אתרי ריכשי ושמואל אמר לא ידענא מאי אדון בה'. Recording Shmuel's earlier position as doubt, not 'second acquires', is correct, and so is keeping Rif's and the Shita's 'רב אמר' as citation witnesses. But Rashbam's lemma 'בי רב אמרי ארכביה כו'' is abbreviated with כו'. Its lack of 'משמיה דרב' is weak evidence and should not become a branch that drops Rav as the source. This chain belongs to the 152a claim; it is referenced from 152b, not added to it.

findings.target: F15 and the correction extending pumb_report to 153a:1
findings.reason: Explicit: Rav Hisda speaks ('אמר להו רב חסדא'). His addressee is marked by 'להו' and is the unnamed subject of 'סבור מיניה'. Also explicit: Rav Huna came from Kufri and explained 'it'. Interpretation: that 'it' ('פירשה') is Shmuel's Pumbedita answer. That rests on Rashbam's gloss 'סבור מיניה הני מילי - דאין לאחר קנין כלום', so the dossier's 'explicit report' label should apply to the speech, not to the object. Store the Rav Huna -> Rav Hisda report once. Note that Ri Migash's quotation lacks 'מכופרי', and that 153a:2 ('ההוא דקנו מיניה אתא לקמיה דרב הונא') is a separate precedent story with an unnamed litigant.

findings.target: F1 / F2 and the corrections to c6, c7
findings.reason: The words 'אימא מודה ליה לשמואל' and 'אימא מודה ליה לרב', framed by 'צריכא', are the anonymous Gemara's rejected suppositions. Keeping them hypothetical and rejected, with no agreement edge, is right. The voice change is mostly a relabel of the pilot's 'narrator'. Rashbam's lemma 'אבל בהך - בתרייתא דלא קנו מיניה ... ואימא מודה לשמואל' does belong to the first half, so the dossier's lemma-variant note points at the right occurrence. Tosafot's own quotation reads 'אי איתמר בההיא בההיא קאמר רב'. That is a citation witness that differs from Rabbeinu Gershom's 'נראה דצ"ל' emendation, and the two should be stored as different evidence types.

c5 ('Rav opposes secondwins') restates the one dispute 'רב אמר ראשון קנה ושמואל אמר שני קנה' and is not a second observation. The same logic applies to pilot c11 ('Shmuel holds_view answer'). It rests on the same words 'שלח להו אין אחר קנין כלום' as c10, so it should be marked as derived from c10 rather than counted separately.

findings.target: F11 (Tosafot: אמרי בי רב = Rav Huna)
findings.reason: Tosafot's 'ועוד דאמרי בי רב הכא ואמרי בי רב היינו רב הונא' belongs to their argument about whether Rav Huna followed his teacher Rav. So 'הכא' points at the 152a:1 'בי רב משמיה דרב אמרי', not the 152b:8 senders. The dossier scopes it correctly as a commentary-sourced candidate. The same Tosafot passage quotes 'והא רב הונא תלמידיה דרב הוה' from Shabbat. That is a quotation of another passage and must not enter this passage's graph as a student_of edge.

The text says only 'כי אתא רב דימי אמר דייתיקי מבטלת דייתיקי'. 'From Eretz Yisrael to Babylonia' is Davidson's addition. At 135b the line answers 'מאי תיבדק' after 'ור' יוחנן אמר תיבדק' without saying Rav Dimi got it from Rabbi Yohanan. The Jerusalem Talmud's 'תני רבן שמעון בן גמליאל אומר דייתיקי מבטלת דייתיקי' is a parallel attribution in another corpus. No origin, destination or transmission edge follows from any of these.

quote_checks.note: 152a:1, the right occurrence (152a:2-3 repeat parts of it as the Gemara's explanation). Shmuel's stance is doubt.
